_comment: Crystallised mana — Alfheim's elemental geodes.
tools/gen_crystals.py turns this into blocks, items, textures, geode features and worldgen.
Design record: alfheim_reclaimed_design/ORE_SUPPLEMENTATION.md §9
SIX CRYSTALS, SIX BIFURCATED GEODES.
Where the ley-lines ran hardest the mana did not merely crystallise into stone (the
Blooms) — it separated by alignment and set as gem. A geode is therefore never one
crystal: it is the boundary between two, and you can see the seam.
HOW BIFURCATION IS DONE, and why it is real rather than a random mix:
the inner layer uses minecraft:noise_threshold_provider, whose selection is driven by
a low-frequency noise field sampled at each block position. Below the threshold the
block comes from low_states, above it from high_states. Because the noise is spatially
coherent at 'scale', a geode 10-16 blocks across usually straddles exactly one boundary
-- so one half is crystal A and the other half is crystal B, with a real seam between.
A weighted_state_provider would have given salt-and-pepper; this gives halves.
PLENTIFUL, AND FINDABLE FROM THE SURFACE:
vanilla amethyst is rarity_filter 24 at absolute y6..30 -- rare, and unrelated to where
the player is standing. Ours are anchored to the LOCAL
SURFACE via heightmap + a negative random_offset, so they sit 14-28 blocks under the
ground the player is walking on.
That anchoring is what makes the surface marker possible. minecraft:environment_scan
caps max_steps at 32, so a marker can only verify a geode within 32 blocks below it.
The marker chain is: heightmap -> environment_scan(down, find a budding crystal) ->
heightmap again (environment_scan moves only Y, so re-running heightmap returns to the
surface at the same x/z). If the scan finds nothing the placement aborts, so a marker
NEVER appears without a geode beneath it -- zero false positives, which is the property
that makes it a trustworthy signal. False negatives are fine.
The marker is itself a small geode of the same two crystals, so it tells the player
WHICH pair is below, not merely that something is.
